_note: Issues followed by the sustainability lens. 'any' = word patterns per language (same rules as config/signals.json: 3 letters or fewer = whole word, 4 = start of a word, 5+ = anywhere in a word, ^ = start of a word, a space = phrase). 'status' and 'next' are hand-written and dated by 'checked'; update them when a milestone passes. 'next_date' (YYYY-MM-DD) drives the countdown. An issue with "context": true is shown only as background: general climate and environment coverage to compare the policy issues against.
